title.en: Gigabit Home Broadband BGP Optimization: Local MTU/MSS Clamping & Fragmentation Troubleshooting

cluster.zh: 多线 BGP 智能中转与入口调度集群

description.zh: 彻底解决千兆光纤下打开代理“网页加载停在 99%”、“大图片持续转圈”与“SSH/Git 会话假死”的技术元凶：PPPoE MTU 1492 与代理隧道报头冲突导致的 IP 数据包分片排障实战。
description.en: Troubleshooting stealth stalls where web pages hang at 99% and SSH sessions freeze, resolving MTU/MSS mismatches between PPPoE (1492) and proxy encapsulation tunnels via MSS clamping.
